$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for Claude Code. CLI-first policy: a server belongs here
ONLY when no CLI equivalent exists. Supabase, Context7, GitHub, shadcn, Playwright,
Vercel and Celery are all driven by their CLIs — see CLAUDE.md 'Tooling policy'.
These two are design-reference surfaces with no CLI, and are used by the architect and
meta agents only; executor subagents are configured with no MCP tools at all (ADR-043).
'open-design' points at a locally installed macOS app, so it will not resolve on another
machine or in CI — that is expected, and it fails closed rather than breaking the build.
